description: This file defines a PHP interface 'RedirectableException' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Exception'. It declares a single method 'getRedirectUrl()' that should return a URL string, indicating that implementing classes will be able to provide redirect URL functionality as part of exception handling.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Method that must be implemented by classes to return a redirect URL as a string.
